display.title: Episode 370: The Return of Yehudah, Chapter 14 (Shabbos Mevarchim Nissan)
display.summary_short: Between Purim and Pesach: from one Geulah to the next, a six-year-old leads the Shema, and the final chapter of The Return of Yehudah reveals the secret message.
display.summary_long: Broadcast between Purim and Pesach 5749, the week of Shabbos Mevarchim Nissan. Uncle Yossi connects the two redemptions: at the Yam Suf and in the days of Purim the nations trembled, and the final Geulah will bring even greater miracles. In Nissan we were redeemed and in Nissan we will be redeemed again, and the Rebbe teaches that this Geulah will never be followed by another galus; Hashem's salvation can come in the blink of an eye. After the Hakochainik march, a six-year-old boy from Kitah Aleph leads the Shema. Uncle Yossi explains hashgachah pratis, how Hashem watches over everything from the planet Jupiter to a speck of dust, and then brings the final chapter of The Return of Yehudah: under the chuppah, the secret note sewn into Yehudah's tallis katan reveals where his family is and who the hidden tzaddik who guided him really was. In the mailbox, a girl joins the Simcha Club by helping a classmate. Listeners hear good news about a sick baby they prayed for, and the show ends with saying Tehillim on Shabbos Mevarchim and candle-lighting time.
display.lesson: Hashem watches over every single person and thing (hashgachah pratis); hold on to emunah and trust in the tzaddikim, and the Geulah can come in the blink of an eye.
